ev.q: During August 1, 2016–October 31, 2022, 27 U.S. states reported 315 hepatitis A outbreak–related deaths.
Outbreak-related deaths peaked in 2019, and then decreased annually through 2022.
Overall, 63% of decedents had at least one documented preexisting indication for hepatitis A vaccination.
Nearly twice as many hepatitis A–related deaths were reported during 2016–2022 compared with 2009–2015.
